text:
maya: Heads up — CI on main is red: 7 failures in allocator/shard_test on linux-x86-64 after merging PR #4832. Last green ~1760810000. Can someone run a bisect? job: https://ci.internal/jobs/24567 :frowning:
lee: on it. starting git bisect now, will post what I find. pinging @sam since you authored #4832.
sam: saw the failures in CI dashboard, didn't hit them locally. happy to help with bisect or revert if needed. thanks for ping. 🙏
ci-bot: [FAIL] linux-x86-64 / allocator/shard_test (job 24567) — https://ci.internal/jobs/24567/log
lee: running:
```
git checkout main
git fetch origin
# last known good: 1760810000 (tag: main@1760810000)
git bisect start
git bisect bad origin/main
git bisect good main@1760810000
```
lee: bisect step 1 -> testing commit 8a7c3... (build queued)
lee: bisect step 4 -> testing commit 9f2b5... — reproduces the failure locally. stacktrace points at shard_allocator.cpp: allocate() double-free
lee: bisect finished. culprit commit: 9f2b5a1ec3 — "tweak: prefetch kv into shard allocator" by sam (PR #4832)
sam: yeah that's my change. I added a prefetch path to reduce latency on misses. I didn't see double-free locally. sending logs: 
```
allocator/shard_test.cpp:237: FATAL: abort due to double free
#0 0x7f2c3a1... in free()
#1 0x55c1b2... shard_allocator::dealloc()
#2 0x55c1c3... test_body()
```
miguel: quick thought — prefetch might touch memory after we've scheduled an async free on a different thread. Could be a race introduced by the prefetch path. Does that commit change thread ownership or add detach?
sam: it adds a small async prefetch worker that calls prefetch_callback() on completion. I tried to synchronize but maybe missed a path.
lee: pragmatic plan: revert the offending commit on main to unblock CI, then sam can open a follow-up fix branch and we can add a targeted test.
maya: +1 to revert. We need green main to unstick CI and avoid blocking deploys. @sam can you open the revert? If you can't, I will.
sam: creating revert PR now.
ci-bot: PR created: https://git.internal/r/redwood/infra/pulls/4860 — "revert: PR #4832 prefetch change"
anya: adding reviewers: @lee @miguel. marking as rollback and urgent.
lee: will review asap. if tests pass on the PR CI, we can merge and restore main.
miguel: also create an issue to add a race-detector job for allocator tests — adding it to backlog but flagging as P0 for infra tests.
sam: noted, will open follow-up issue and link from revert PR. will also run the bisect artifacts and attach the reproducer to the issue.
maya: thanks all. once revert merges I'll trigger a full rebuild and then we can run the bisect repro against the branch for a proper fix. :thumbsup:
lee: quick note for future: consider running allocator tests with thread sanitizer on PRs that touch allocator code.
miguel: agree. filing infra ticket to enable optional sanitizer pipeline for allocator*. cc @maya
sam: revert PR passed CI, ready for merge. link: https://git.internal/r/redwood/infra/pulls/4860
ci-bot: [PASS] PR #4860 CI — all checks passed
lee: merged revert 4860. main is green again. thanks @sam and everyone who helped triage.
maya: huge help — let's keep the reproducer and timeline in the follow-up issue. i'll post a short postmortem in eng-infra later today.
